messages:
maria: Hi team — RCA for the 2026-03-20 serving degradation is published (internal): https://redwood.app/rcas/1965-serving-degradation. TL;DR: kernel-selection mismatch + canary routing edge case led to a spike in 500s from ~03:12–03:45 UTC; hotfix rolled at 03:50 and traffic stabilized. Please read the doc and add any missing details by EOD. /cc @jin @sam

sam: Reading now, thanks. Can you summarize customer impact here?

maria: Minimal SLO exposure overall, but 12 orgs experienced elevated latencies (~2x) for ~30 minutes. No data exfiltration. Product will redact specific customer details and publish a customer-facing note.

jin: I'll draft the customer-facing note and coordinate with CS. ETA EOD PT.

arun: Oncall will take the "rollback guard" action — I'll add an automated canary check + fail-open behavior to the deploy pipeline. Owner: arun, ETA: 2026-03-27.

ben: I'll own stabilizing the quantization test infra that surfaced flaky kernel behavior. Owner: ben, ETA: 2026-04-02.

incident-bot: Action items created in Tracker: T-1965-1 rollback-guard (arun), T-1965-2 quant-test-fix (ben), T-1965-3 routing-fallback (maria).

maria: Callout — short list of action items in the RCA: 
- rollback-guard: add fail-open guard + prod canary check (owner: arun) — due 2026-03-27
- routing-fallback: ensure immediate fallback to compatible model variant when kernel mismatch detected (owner: maria) — due 2026-03-30
- quant-test-fix: add deterministic repro harness + per-run metrics (owner: ben) — due 2026-04-02

sam: Small request — can we add a follow-up checkpoint one week after the last due date to verify no regressions?

maria: Good idea. Scheduling a follow-up checkpoint: 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants and interested parties.

jin: Confirmed — I'll join and bring the draft customer note + impact summary.

arun: I'll update the oncall runbook with the new checklist and link to the RCA.

maria: Also: quick infra notes — the hotfix toggled a fallback path that reduced latency but increased token cost temporarily. Optimize path queued as part of routing-fallback item.

sam: Noted. Also added a comment in the RCA about adding a short section on monitoring thresholds to avoid noisy alerts.

maria: Thanks everyone. If anyone sees related anomalies in canary, please ping #eng-oncall immediately. :eyes:

sam: :thumbsup:
